title: Community Duels
subtitle: Challenge a tipster on an upcoming match. Calls stay hidden until kick-off, the community votes, and Puntr settles it at full time.

how.title: How duels work
how.s1: Pick a match and make 2 or 3 calls: Match result, Both teams to score, Over/Under 2.5.
how.s2: Challenge a member by username or post an open challenge. Add a friendly PuntPoints stake when staking is on.
how.s3: Calls stay hidden until kick-off, then show side by side. The community votes on who called it better.
how.s4: At full time the member with more correct calls takes the pot and duel XP (win 3, draw 1). Ties and void matches return the stakes.
